WasteClassification.title: WasteClassification
WasteClassification.description: A single AI-powered waste classification scan record stored per user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

itemName.description: Identified waste item description (e.g., PET Plastic Bottle).

isUncertain.description: True when confidence is below the certainty threshold (0.65).

binColor.description: Recommended bin type or color label.

ecoTip.description: Additional preparation or environmental impact note.

sourceType.description: Capture method used for this classification.

/users/{userId}/classifications/{classif.description: Per-user waste classification history and analytics records.
